theorems.name: Submission.idtp_fons_cc_psf_injective
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (μ₀ : Measure (Euclid P)), 1 ≤ n → μ₀ univ ≠ 0 → μ₀ univ ≠ ∞ → μ₀ (ball (0 : Euclid P) 2)ᶜ = 0 → ∀ (x x' : Euclid P) (lam lam' : ℝ), 0 < lam → 0 < lam' → ENNReal.ofReal (lam⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x lam) = ENNReal.ofReal (lam'⁻¹ ^ n) • μ₀.map (dilation x' lam') → x = x' ∧ lam = lam'
